priorityList: Use Death Coil when you have a Sudden Doom proc or 80+ Runic Power.
Use Death Coil as a filler spell.
Apply and maintain Virulent Plague using Outbreak
Cast Army of the Dead on cooldown to summon the Horsemen of the Apocalypse
Cast Apocalypse when the target has 4 or more Festering Wounds to summon additional Horsemen
Cast Soul Reaper if the target is below 35% health
Cast Death Coil if a Sudden Doom proc is active
Cast Festering Strike if the target has fewer than 4 Festering Wounds
Cast Scourge Strike or Clawing Shadows if the target has 1 or more Festering Wounds
Cast Death Coil to spend excess Runic Power and reduce major cooldowns via Army of the Damned
